surveyed.source: Backlog destination "Spanjemonument" (extract_landmarks_1299755268); the steel ribbon, the two flying bronzes, the paving circle and the brick wall with its pink plaque read from Wikimedia Commons photographs (Ceescamel CC BY-SA 4.0; Eddy Roos CC BY-SA 4.0) and Gemeente Amsterdam panorama TMX7316010203-001303_pano_0002_000532 (2019, CC BY 4.0, 5 m away); the facing (235 degrees, +-30, the flight direction) comes from that panorama; the wall position (3.7 m ahead of the flight) and the 5.4 m height are estimates

attribution.title: Spanjemonument (Amsterdam-Noord) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Eddy Roos (1986); figure reconstructed from photographs by Eddy Roos, Ceescamel, Roland Gerrits / Anefo
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Spanje monument groot.jpg" by Eddy Roos (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Spanje_monument_groot.jpg); "2021 Spanjemonument-beeld (4).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2021_Spanjemonument-beeld_(4).jpg); "2021 Spanjemonument-beeld (1).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2021_Spanjemonument-beeld_(1).jpg); "Opdracht Tendenzen Spanje-Monument, Bestanddeelnr 933-6767.jpg" by Roland Gerrits / Anefo (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Opdracht_Tendenzen_Spanje-Monument,_Bestanddeelnr_933-6767.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/spanjemonument.json.
